title: Marketing copy calls a newcomer's first visit their first gathering and keeps it optional, not their first night
detail: Owner ruling 2026-10-14: change marketing copy from "Your first night" to "your first gathering", and keep it loose so a first visit never reads as obligatory or vulnerable. Changed: the People page section, its chapter link and its CTA (frequency-people.tsx, with softer cards: join in or just watch, leave when you need to), the site nav and footer labels (lib/frequency/site-nav.ts), the Circles discover lede in both designs (components/frequency/site/pages/discover/circles.tsx, app/discover/circles/page.tsx), and the CircleFirstNight block defaults plus the home and the-community templates (title, footnote, and run-sheet notes that make sharing optional). Left on purpose: the #first-night anchor id (existing links), the host-facing "first-night script" phrasing, help articles for hosts, and the Wildheart Space site, whose copy is pinned to its own design mock by scripts/probes/wildheart-content-checklist.json.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f=['components/frequency/site/pages/people/frequency-people.tsx','lib/frequency/site-nav.ts','components/frequency/site/pages/discover/circles.tsx','app/discover/circles/page.tsx','components/page-editor/blocks/product-story.tsx','lib/page-editor/templates/home.ts','lib/page-editor/templates/the-community.ts'];const bad=f.filter(p=>/[Ff]irst night/.test(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')));if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-868: marketing copy still says first night in '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}if(!/Your first gathering/.test(fs.readFileSync('lib/frequency/site-nav.ts','utf8'))){console.error('SCAN-868: the nav no longer offers Your first gathering');process.exit(1)}"
verify.evidence: Probe exits 1 on origin/main (seven files say first night) and 0 on this branch. vitest lib/frequency/site-nav.test.ts, lib/page-editor/templates, lib/site.cta.test.ts, scripts/maintenance/home-copy-canon.test.ts and components/frequency/site pass (17 files, 180 tests).
